scope: Verifier finding P1 (low), 2026-11-02: blobs.vert ran its whole body in the pick render and then called TDWritePickingValues() under #ifdef, not the documented '#ifndef TD_PICKING_ACTIVE ... #else TDWritePickingValues(); #endif'. 'Before' is blobs.vert as the verifier saw it (identical to 6a58487); 'after' is the delivered file. glslang and plain Python only; nothing ran in TouchDesigner.

documentation.write_a_glsl_mat: https://docs.derivative.ca/Write_a_GLSL_MAT (oldid 38399, modified 2026-08-05, read 2026-11-02): '#ifndef TD_PICKING_ACTIVE // All the typical shader code #else TDWritePickingValues(); #endif' and 'when picking is occuring, the define TD_PICKING_ACTIVE is set and only the code inside the #else block is executed'.
documentation.exported_mat_shader: https://docs.derivative.ca/Syntaxhighlight (last edited 27 September 2017, read 2026-11-02): an exported MAT vertex shader computes 'vec4 worldSpacePos = TDDeform(P); gl_Position = TDWorldToProj(worldSpacePos);' before '#ifndef TD_PICKING_ACTIVE', and calls TDWritePickingValues() in the #else block.

method: glslangValidator -E (preprocess only) of blobs.vert with and without '#define TD_PICKING_ACTIVE'; the statements of main() listed. The unit test does the same with a small Python preprocessor (#ifdef/#ifndef/#else/#endif), which gives the same lists.

unit_test_red_run.code: blobs.vert before the fix, checks/test_study.py after it
unit_test_red_run.result: 61 tests, 2 failures: test_pick_render_runs_only_the_documented_picking_block (10 statements in the pick render, 3 expected) and test_extra_colour_buffers_are_zeroed_with_constant_indices ('#ifndef TD_PICKING_ACTIVE' not found; this assertion changed on purpose from '#ifdef', see review.md#picking-form-fix).

compile_after: checks/results/compile.json: blobs.vert and blobs.vert (pick render) pass in GLSL 4.60 and Vulkan relaxed modes, as before.

look.method: All 24 preset tiles (12 presets on Checker and Type, time 3 s, 800 x 450 in an 870 x 491 screenshot) rendered with the fixed blobs.vert in the WebGL2 (SwiftShader) preview and compared with the stored captures.
look.note: The preview never defines TD_PICKING_ACTIVE, so it renders the ordinary branch; the pick render itself cannot be previewed.
